title: AI Already Passes as Human Better Than Real Humans (UC San Diego Study)
description: New research from UC San Diego shows that AI can actually seem more human than real humans in Turing tests. The study used ChatGPT 4.5 with the right persona prompts in live chat scenarios, and the results were shocking. This raises serious questions about online trust and what we consider authentically human in digital interactions. With AI images, videos, and OpenAI's new real-time language translation getting incredibly sophisticated, we're entering territory where distinguishing between AI and human becomes nearly impossible. The implications for online communication, verification, and digital authenticity are massive. This isn't just a technical achievement, it's a fundamental shift in how we'll need to approach human interaction online.
